question: Compare normal and exception lubrication plus inspection intervals for the Caldra Tide Station salt-spray winch and Tessarin Repair Cafe dusty-workroom bench drill.
answer:
[1] The Caldra Tide Station winch needs lubrication every 84 operating hours under normal conditions.

[2] Lubricate the Tessarin Repair Cafe bench drill every 104 operating hours under normal conditions. In a dusty workroom, lubricate it every 52 operating hours. Inspect the drill every 26 operating hours in either room.
